frequency_question: What proportion of court-mandated executive regulatory finalisations are completed and filed within a 30-day window?
membership_rule: Includes all instances where a supreme judicial body ordered a specific bureaucratic rule finalisation with a compliance window under 30 days. Excludes voluntary rulemakings and windows exceeding 30 days.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named historical instances of sub-30-day supreme court compliance windows for complex rulemakings; believed exhaustive for this exact class.
known_gaps: Extremely tight judicial windows for complex administrative rules are rare because administrative processes inherently exceed 30 days for drafting, inter-ministerial consultation, and formal notification.
validity_reason: Administrative procedure laws and bureaucratic drafting speeds remain constant over medium-term horizons.
